cases.doc: The engine's documented example: long on the first bar and flat on the third, each filled at the next bar's open.
Ten basis points on the entry and on the exit: the quantity bought is a division the engine rounds, and crosses with every digit it has.
A position still open after the last bar is sold at that bar's close, fee included, before on_finish is called.
Without close-out the position is only valued at the last close: on_finish is handed it still held, and no trade is recorded.
A strategy that never decides is called for every bar and stays flat.
Asking for the position already held changes nothing: long while long, and flat while flat.
A decision on the last bar has no next open to fill at, and never fills.
One candle: on_start, one on_bar and on_finish, all at its open time.
In, out, in and out again: the second entry spends what the first trade left.
Prices and a volume with trailing zeros, eight decimal places and none, and a trade count the exchange did not report: each reaches the strategy as it was given.
The candles are not checked: out of order and one of them twice, they are replayed as given, and now_ms follows each bar's own open time.
Another venue's Spot line, another symbol and eight-hour bars: every context names the market of the run, and a trade its symbol.
Open times below zero are times like any other.
An entry that would fill at an open of zero is skipped, and the strategy is handed its cash untouched.
Sixty bars of a price that swings, entered and left every nine bars at 7.5 basis points: six trades a decision ends, and a seventh closed out at the end.
A failure in on_start ends the run before any bar.
A failure on the second bar, with a position just entered, ends the run there: no bar follows, nothing is closed out, and on_finish is not called.
A failure in on_finish, after every bar and the close-out, still fails the run: there is no result.
